name: Home check
summary: Late night after a party: the town drawn small with a house for each friend and their dot walking home; tap I'm home to light your window, check on whoever's still out, and it settles to 'All 6 home' and goes quiet.
useWhen: 'text when ur home' after a party or a late night out
making sure everyone got back safe without a dozen separate texts
dontUseWhen: planning a ride before leaving (use event-carpool or pickup-run)

params.title: string
params.people: up to 8 x {name, home (H:MM got home or ''), walked (0-9), said, reply (what they say when checked on), detour (passes the halal cart)}
